caption: The drawing depicts a metallic tool composed of two elongated handles connected at a joint and ending in two different shapes: one end forms a semi-circular, arch-like clamp while the other forms a circular ring. The tool appears to be made of a dull, silver-gray metal with subtle shading to indicate its three-dimensional form and some brownish tones indicating age or tarnish. To the right of the tool, there are two concentric oval or elliptical rings sketched in a light brown color, with broken, hand-drawn lines. The objects are placed on a plain, off-white background, and there is a small printed label on the bottom left that reads "Elizabeth Johnson." The drawing is contained within a faint rectangular border.
title: Branding Iron
